_comment: Areas the satellite scanner checks every week. Each bbox is [west, south, east, north] in degrees; keep them around 10 x 6 km so a scan fits in one GitHub Actions job. Set enabled to false to pause a region. 'profile' picks the crop rules in xylella_scanner.py (olive when missing; also almond, grapevine), and 'mask' names the parcel register that limits the scan to that crop (see crop_masks.py) - give every non-olive region a mask. 'role' tells the app how to read a detection: 'established' = inside the official infected zone (decline is expected), 'front' = at the advancing edge where official sampling still happens (good for checking the scanner), 'outbreak' = a recent isolated official outbreak, 'experimental' = crop or setting the thresholds were not derived for.

regions.name: Ostuni coastal plain (BR), Puglia
regions.official_status: Inside the official infected zone for X. fastidiosa subsp. pauca. In a CNR field study in Gorgognolo (Ostuni) in September 2022, 78 of 235 sampled olive trees tested positive.

regions.name: Monopoli – Polignano a Mare (BA), Puglia
regions.official_status: Advancing edge of the pauca outbreak. Infected olive trees were officially confirmed here in 2022 (about 20 near Polignano in August–September, 23 in the then pest-free part of Monopoli by October), so detections can be checked against the Region's published monitoring data.

sources.title: Regione Puglia monitoring, as reported Oct 2022

regions.name: Monopoli (BA) – Fasano (BR), Puglia
regions.official_status: Advancing edge of the pauca outbreak, south-east of Monopoli–Polignano. The Region's inspectors sampled 71,769 olive trees here from 2020 to mid-2023 and found 179 positive (168 in Fasano, 11 in Monopoli), with positives in every campaign year. Added as a second area for checking the scanner against official results.

sources.title: Regione Puglia, Dati monitoraggio Xylella fastidiosa, campaigns 2020–2023 (CC BY 4.0)

regions.name: Bisceglie (BT), Puglia
regions.official_status: Demarcated area for subsp. pauca after infected olive trees were found north of Bari in 2025, then the northernmost record in Puglia's main olive district.

regions.name: Cagnano Varano, Gargano (FG), Puglia
regions.official_status: Demarcated area for subsp. pauca established in October 2025 after 47 infected olive trees were confirmed: the first outbreak in the province of Foggia.

regions.name: Taurianova, Gioia Tauro plain (RC), Calabria
regions.official_status: First subsp. pauca outbreak in Calabria: 7 infected olive trees confirmed in August 2026; demarcated area set up on 1 September 2026 and redrawn on 8 September 2026.

regions.name: Pla de Mallorca almond orchards, Balearic Islands
regions.official_status: Balearic Islands are under containment; EPPO reports a high incidence of Xylella on almond in Mallorca. Scanned with the almond profile, only inside dry-fruit orchard parcels from the SIGPAC register (codes FS, FL, FV: mostly almond on Mallorca).

sources.title: EPPO Global Database: X. fastidiosa subsp. fastidiosa in Spain
